governingPrinciple: Portrait capture is source material, never final geometry.
required: The dominant visual occupies the cinematic field at a scale comparable to successful live Awards videos.
Browser chrome, Android navigation chrome, and phone-edge framing are excluded from the authored cinematic field whenever they are not story material.
No shot may read as a small phone screen floating inside black space.
No black-band solution may be created merely by shrinking the portrait capture.
Important visual information must survive through reframing, pan-scan, or cinematic compositing.
Text appears only on dedicated dark canvas or reduced-demand transition windows.
Major visual reveals do not compete with reading.
The first sentence appears before moving website footage.

compatibilityGate.frameOccupancy: PASS only when the intended subject, not the device viewport, dominates the 16:9 frame.
compatibilityGate.deviceRead: PASS only when representative frames do not visually announce a phone recording.
compatibilityGate.textBandwidth: PASS only when reading windows have deliberately reduced visual demand.
compatibilityGate.liveEquivalence: PASS only when representative candidate frames are compositionally consistent with the scale and integration of the successful live videos.
